title: Mx 1.1.0 is ready!
message:
• Fixed: Disable All Ads against current Telegram TL (sponsored messages, search peers, promo chat)
• Fixed: anti-self-destruct, Custom Stars, and screenshot block
• Fixed: fake location at null island and story ghost exceptions
• Download boost and file-picker fix now apply as soon as you toggle them
• Ghost Advanced Settings and Change Language follow your selected language
• Removed the Credits section and unused disclaimer copy
